title: Champagne On Mars From Better Luck Tomorrow
ldName: Champagne On Mars From Better Luck Tomorrow
ldInstructionsRaw: Shake the first 4 ingredients with ice, then double strain into a chilled glass. Top with sparkling wine, then garnish.

Hibiscus-Infused Galliano: In a glass jar, combine 1 oz. of dried hibiscus with 10 oz. of Galliano. Cover the jar and let the mixture infuse for 6 to 8 hours, to taste. Strain out the solids and bottle for use.
